label: The articles of the Swiss Federal Act on Data Protection (nDSG/revFADP, SR 235.1, of 25 September 2020, in force since 1 September 2023) that the documents cite, with each article's heading; recorded by hand from the act's published text, not fetched by code. The claims check binds every cited article number (docs/dpo_checklist.md, the decision pages, README, runbook) to this file, so a changed number fails until the file and the sentence agree.

register.cited_for: the register of processing activities the DPO checklist fills in, one entry per line

disclosure_abroad.cited_for: the Public AI route: document text disclosed abroad without a processing agreement (results/compliance/publicai_terms.json assessment.ndsg_article)

automated_decision.cited_for: Gegenprobe takes no automated individual decisions

impact_assessment.cited_for: whether the body's rules call for a data protection impact assessment, left to the DPO
